faq.title: Answers to your questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your emotional baby scan at EcoNane.
faq.q1: What is the best week for a 4D/5D baby scan?
faq.a1: You can visit from week 12 for gender reveals or listening to heartbeats, but the best weeks to see clear, realistic facial features are between week 24 and week 30.
faq.q2: What happens if my baby won't show their face?
faq.a2: Don't worry at all! EcoNane includes a Free Rescan Guarantee: if baby is turned away or covering their face, we will pause or reschedule your session at no cost to ensure you get wonderful photos.
faq.q3: Can my family or children join the scan?
faq.a3: Absolutely! Our studio is equipped with comfortable seating and a large cinema display so the entire family can share this experience together.
faq.q4: How do the combined Ultrasound + Photography packages work?
faq.a4: Together with Penélope Photograph, we perform the ultrasound and professional photoshoot on the same day (usually on Fridays). You pay conveniently once at the clinic, and Penélope delivers your digital photos directly to you.
